warn.description: Warn a member and add warning points.

kick.description: Kick a member from the server.

ban.description: Ban a user from the server (optionally temporary).

softban.description: Softban a user (ban with 1 day message deletion, then unban).

unban.description: Unban a user from the server.

purge.description: Delete messages in bulk with optional filters.

lock.description: Lock, unlock, or set slowmode on a channel.

lockdown.description: Lock down or unlock all public text channels in the server.

menu.description: Open your Track Modest hub — profile, quests, games, and more.

settings.description: Configure server settings via an interactive panel.
